verdict.rationale: GitBook has a dedicated first-party docs page titled "Authenticated access" under its site-audience publishing section. That indicates the platform can gate published docs behind authentication for restricted audiences. However, the pack shows only the page title, not how gating works or which methods are supported. Missing for 10: evidence of password protection, JWT/visitor-token auth, SSO/identity-provider integration, per-section (partial-site) gating, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
